question: When may an imported module body be omitted from semantic checking?
decision: A validated imported cdi sidecar with its paired module product is the dependency semantic input; dependency-order scheduling completes that preloaded node without entering the source-body checker, while source-backed entries and cache fallback or repair paths retain body checking.

compatibility_boundary.direct_inputs: single-file and ordered direct-multi-file programs retain their combined entry path
compatibility_boundary.module_products: cold builds and repairs retain source fallback

migration.preloaded_hit: scheduler marks the interface node complete without TypeChecker::checkModule
migration.source_fallback: parsed modules remain body-checked and diagnostic-authoritative
migration.observability: checkedModuleBodyIds records only source bodies that completed semantic checking

quantitative_gate.complete_hit: frontend_session_tests records only the entry module body
quantitative_gate.partial_reuse: frontend_session_tests records source-backed importer and entry bodies but not the valid lower dependency
quantitative_gate.fallback: frontend_session_tests records both source-backed module bodies

old_path_deletion_condition: Do not remove module-product source fallback, entry source loading, or graph transport adapters until independently validated product/content and diagnostic evidence covers cold, repair, stale, malformed, and partial-reuse builds.
